modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Myway's conditions of carriage say these options are your sole remedies, except as the Convention provides.

rebooking_refund.value: If Myway cancels a flight, fails to operate it reasonably according to schedule, fails to stop at your destination or stopover, or causes you to miss a confirmed connection, you choose between: carriage at the earliest opportunity on another Myway service with space, at no extra charge; re-routing within a reasonable time by Myway or another carrier at no extra charge; or a refund.

refund_amount.value: In those cases the refund is the full fare paid if no part of the ticket has been used; if part has been used, not less than the difference between the fare paid and the fare for the sectors flown.

schedule_change.value: If Myway makes a significant change to the scheduled flight time after you buy your ticket and it is not acceptable to you, you are entitled to a refund.

checkin_deadline.value: Check-in deadlines differ by airport; unless otherwise stated, the check-in deadline for Myway flights is 40 minutes before departure. Myway may cancel your reservation if you miss it.
